name: Traditional Fantasy
description: Grounded sword-and-sorcery fantasy — the default this whole prototype was built against.
tone: Grounded sword-and-sorcery fantasy. Magic is real but not casual to cast or to witness; danger is physical first (blades, monsters, wilderness, dungeons) with the supernatural as an occasional, notable exception rather than the everyday backdrop.

vocabulary.weapon_flavor: blades, bows, axes, and old steel

narration_notes: Checks are called by their 5e-style names (Investigation, Perception, Athletics, etc.). Treat found gear, coin, and combat in classic fantasy terms — no technology anachronisms unless the campaign's own canon has introduced one.
